strategies.overview:
Water

Cloyster is generally outclassed on Water teams, its poor defensive typing and lacking offensive prowess before setting up compared to options like Primarina and Urshifu-R makes finding that turn to get in and use Shell Smash difficult. However, should it overcome these hurdles, Cloyster can be a meance being able to rip through types like Dragon and Ice and completely flip games on their head.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Ice

Ice Beam is an alternative option, useful for hitting physically defensive walls, such as Archaludon without massively boosting its defense, Skarmory, or Hippowdon.

movesets.name: Shell Smash (Water)
movesets.description:
Thanks to its excellent offensive movepool and access to Shell Smash, Cloyster finds a niche on Water teams. Thanks to Cloyster's high Defense stat, it can reliably use Shell Smash in front of some of the tier's premier physical attackers, such as Ceruledge and Mamoswine. Ice Beam is a great option to hit physically defensive foes such as Archaludon, Skarmory, and Great Tusk; it hits the former without activating Stamina. Hydro Pump is an option to prevent Cloyster from being entirely passive against Steel-types, namely Gholdengo and Heatran, whereas Ice Shard is helpful for picking off threats that may move before Cloyster even after a Shell Smash boost, such as Sucker Punch Dragapult and Choice Scarf Flutter Mane. Icicle Spear is excellent for hitting Flying-, Ground-, and Dragon-type Pokemon, such as Tornadus-T, Clodsire, and Latios, as well as breaking Focus Sash or Sturdy on Pokemon such as Breloom and Ogerpon-C. After a Shell Smash, the given EV spread, coupled with Never-Melt Ice, allows Cloyster to OHKO Choice Scarf Archaludon with Ice Beam, as well as defensive Archaludon and Hisuian Goodra with Ice Beam and Icicle Spear, respectively, after a layer of Spikes.

Hisuian Samurott is a great teammate for Cloyster, as the Spikes it provides with Ceaseless Edge are very important for Cloyster. If Cloyster opts to use three Ice-type moves, then Hisuian Samurott can weaken opposing Steel-types, such as Heatran and Empoleon, with Sacred Sword. Ogerpon-W is a fantastic teammate for Cloyster, as Cloyster's moveset notably leaves it weak against other Water-types, such as Alomomola and Primarina. Ogerpon-W remedies this issue by threatening these Pokemon with either Horn Leech or Power Whip. Swampert and Alomomola are both great teammates for Cloyster, as they both act as slow pivot options to help Cloyster get in more easily. Swampert can also provide Knock Off and Stealth Rock support while being immune to Electric, whereas Alomomola can use Wish to keep Cloyster healthy in case it takes some entry hazard damage. Fighting-types such as Urshifu-R and Keldeo complement Cloyster excellently, as they can help weaken Steel-types, such as Gholdengo and Skarmory, so that Cloyster can have an easier time sweeping. Additionally, both of these Pokemon have pivoting options in the form of U-turn and Flip Turn, respectively, allowing Cloyster to come in when the Fighting-types scare something out. Toxapex can use Toxic to weaken foes that Cloyster cannot OHKO, such as Urshifu-R and Iron Hands. Toxapex can also use Haze to prevent opposing setup sweepers from getting too out of hand, which gives Cloyster more opportunities to use Shell Smash. Tentacruel can provide hazard control with Rapid Spin, ensuring Cloyster will have an easier time finding an opportunity to use Shell Smash, as well as using Toxic Spikes of its own to chip down opposing Pokemon. Additionally, Tentacruel has Flip Turn to help Cloyster hit the field more easily.

movesets.name: Shell Smash Sweeper (Ice)
movesets.description:
Cloyster is one of Ice's best setup sweepers thanks to its access to Shell Smash in addition to its high Defense stat, which gives it opportunities to set up on the tier's physical attackers like Garchomp, Iron Treads, and Ceruledge. Icicle Spear targets opposing Flying-, Ground-, and Dragon-type Pokemon such as Tornadus-T, Clodsire, and Dragapult while breaking Focus Sash on Pokemon such as Breloom. Rock Blast benefits from Skill Link and threatens Fire-types like Ceruledge and other Ice-type Pokemon like Kyurem. Ice Shard is useful for revenge killing faster Choice Scarf Pokemon that are weakened like Spectrier, Meowscarada, and Roaring Moon. Hydro Pump is the alternative in order to not be walled by opposing Steel-types like Gholdengo and Forretress. It is also beneficial for threatening Heatran and Mamoswine, both of which are troublesome for Ice teams, as well as Torkoal and Ninetales, easing the Fire matchup. Maximum Speed investment with a Jolly nature allows +2 Cloyster to outspeed Choice Scarf users such as Walking Wake and Great Tusk; a Naive nature with the remaining 4 EVs going into Special Attack should be used if opting for Hydro Pump to not reduce its damage. White Herb is Cloyster's preferred item, as it is able to offset the stat drops of Shell Smash, which makes Cloyster harder to revenge kill. Focus Sash is the alternative to always guarantee one turn of setup when at full health, but it is less preferred because Cloyster is already difficult to OHKO under snow or Aurora Veil.

Cloyster's best partner on Ice is Alolan Ninetales. Alolan Ninetales allows Cloyster to have an easier time to set up thanks to it setting snow, which, when combined with Aurora Veil, allows Cloyster to set up on Pokemon that can usually threaten it out like offensive Great Tusk and Cinderace. Alolan Ninetales also provides Encore support to force uncomfortable switches, thus granting Cloyster an easier entry, as well as handling Unaware Pokemon like Quagsire and Dondozo with its STAB Freeze-Dry. Cloyster is able to threaten Fire's weather setters Ninetales and Torkoal after a boost, which benefits Alolan Ninetales, as it can come back in to reset snow for its teammates. Cloyster appreciates Kyurem as an offensive partner, as Choice Specs sets are able to weaken Cloyster's defensive checks like Toxapex and Archaludon. Mamoswine is an excellent partner for Cloyster, as not only can it provide entry hazard support in the form of Stealth Rock, but it can also remove items from opposing defensive staples such as Corviknight and Toxapex with Knock Off. Alolan Sandslash can provide Knock Off support for Cloyster and use Rapid Spin to remove entry hazards, allowing for easier entry to set up and making it much more difficult to KO, Avalugg can also support Cloyster with Rapid Spin and handle its physical offensive checks like Great Tusk under snow. Froslass is Ice's only viable option for Spikes, which Cloyster appreciates, as defensive Pokemon like Hatterene and Iron Hands aren't able to check it properly after a boost and entry hazard damage. Additionally, Froslass can hinder opposing threats with Thunder Wave, allowing Cloyster to outspeed Pokemon that are normally faster than it even with a Shell Smash boost, such as Choice Scarf Roaring Moon and Unburden Sneasler.

strategies.outdated: This analysis was for Battle Stadium Singles Regulation C, which ended on June 30th, 2023. Since then, this Pokemon's viability has massively dropped off, and it is no longer relevant. Using this Pokemon in today's metagame is not advised unless you have an extremely niche, hyper-specific need to cover.

movesets.name: Shell Smash Sweeper
movesets.description:
• Shell Smash and Skill Link more than make up for Cloyster's weak Attack stat, making it a formidable sweeper that Focus Sash and Mimikyu can't easily stop.

  • Ice Shard: Priority may seem like overkill, but it helps pick off weakened threats without setup. It also gets around priority attacks from Breloom, Dragapult, and Meowscarada after a Shell Smash.

  • Rock Blast: This is Closyer's best shot at dealing with the many Tera Fires that resist Icicle Spear, as well as OHKOing Chien-Pao, Iron Bundle, and Iron Moth.

  • Drill Run: This hits Gholdengo and other Steel-types hard without needing to Terastallize.

  • Adamant versus Jolly: Adamant is the preferred nature to maximize offensive power, as a single Shell Smash lets you outspeed the entire unboosted metagame. However, Cloyster is in the same speed tier as Breloom, so Jolly is a consideration if you want to minimize Speed tie scenarios in that matchup.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependency - Medium: As a Focus Sash user, Cloyster wants to avoid using Tera when possible, but opposing priority attacks and defensive typings can sometimes make it a necessity.

  • Ghost: Since Cloyster will often be at extremely low health after Shell Smash, Tera Ghost helps it avoid getting revenge killed by Breloom's Mach Punch and Dragonite’s Extreme Speed. It also provides coverage against Gholdengo with Tera Blast.

  • Ice: The increased damage from Tera Ice makes it very difficult for Pokemon to wall Cloyster without resisting it, with even Corviknight getting OHKOed by +2 Adamant Icicle Spear after Stealth Rock damage.

  • Ground: Volt Switch users like Rotom-W love to take Cloyster down to its Focus Sash and pivot to a priority attacker; Tera Ground both nullifies the damage and prevents the switch, giving Cloyster significant momentum with a free turn to Shell Smash. It also lets Cloyster challenge defensive Gholdengo, blocking Thunder Wave and giving +2 Adamant Drill Run a strong chance to OHKO.

  • Fire: While Tera Fire Tera Blast actually does less damage to Corviknight than Tera Ice Icicle Spear, Tera Fire otherwise helps Cloyster muscle past Steel-types it traditionally struggles to beat, such as Scizor.

  • Normal: Tera Normal is a niche option that offers no offensive benefits to Cloyster, but it does prevent Mimikyu and Gallade from revenge killing it with Shadow Sneak.

Items

  • Focus Sash: Considering Cloyster's paper-thin Special Defense, Focus Sash gives Cloyster by far the most setup opportunities.

  • King's Rock: King's Rock is a risky option that doesn’t help Cloyster set up, but it does give Icicle Spear and Rock Blast a 41% chance of flinching.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 7 onwards

Price Range: 5-6 points

Overview: Cloyster boasts a gargantuan Defense stat that allows it to set up Shell Smash on a variety of physical attackers. Thanks to Skill Link, it can use STAB Icicle Spear to smash past unsuspecting walls and offensive threats alike. It also has useful utility moves like Spikes and Toxic Spikes in case a Shell Smash set does not work as well in a matchup. Unfortunately, its pitiful special bulk, its low Speed stat that allows many Choice Scarf users to outspeed it even after a Shell Smash, the existence of Mirror Herb, and its inability to hit the ever-common bulky Water-types make it difficult to fit onto drafts.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: Shell Smash in combination with Skill Link, Icicle Spear, Rock Blast, and coverage moves makes Cloyster an extremely dangerous late-game setup sweeper if it is not planned accordingly for.

Utility Tank: Although Cloyster's defensive typing leaves much to be desired, physical attackers that struggle with hitting it super effectively can allow it to set up entry hazards.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Icicle Spear, Ice Shard, Liquidation, Waterfall

Setup Moves: Shell Smash

Utility Moves: Spikes, Toxic Spikes

Coverage: Drill Run, Poison Jab, Rock Blast, Smart Strike

Niche Moves

Special Attacks: Since physical walls are a common way for opponents to deal with Cloyster, it can opt for a mixed set to take advantage of the Shell Smash boost it gets to fire off powerful special moves such as Hydro Pump and Ice Beam.

Substitute: While Substitute takes up a useful moveslot for coverage options, sometimes it is essential in allowing Cloyster to safely set up a Shell Smash.

Common Items

Focus Sash: While Cloyster can tank most physical attacks with little problem, special attacks will often OHKO it regardless of a Special Defense drop. Lead Cloyster can use this item without having to worry about its Focus Sash being broken by entry hazards to wreak some immediate havoc.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Cloyster is extremely prone to being chipped by entry hazards and KOed the turn it attempts to set up. With Heavy-Duty Boots, it will likely always be able to survive a physical attack. This is also its most useful item on tank sets, allowing it to switch in multiple times into hazards.

White Herb: Letting Cloyster offset the drops Shell Smash gives it with White Herb can make it much harder to revenge kill; this also allows it to set up on slower foes without having to worry about taking increased damage from them.

Niche Items

Rocky Helmet: On tank sets, Cloyster can hold Rocky Helmet to punish some of the physical attacks it looks to tank.

Tera

Cloyster works much better flying under the radar and getting surprise sweeps against unsuspecting foes. Being a Tera Captain would help it greatly, giving it the option to gain coverage for bulky Water-types with Tera Electric, bolster the attacks it wants to use the most with Tera Ice or Rock, or attempt to give itself a better defensive typing such as Ghost, which can also be used to spinblock, or Steel.

Draft Strategy

Cloyster works best on fast-paced offensive drafts, having the option to set entry hazards to assist its team or set up to sweep on its own.

Setup Sweepers: Pokemon such as Zarude, Iron Valiant, and Raging Bolt that can help maintain a fast tempo while also having the option to soak up Mirror Herbs really help pave the way for Cloyster. Additionally, these Pokemon appreciate that it can get on the field early with Focus Sash sets to weaken some tanks for them.

Sacrificial Leads: Pokemon that can be dedicated sacrificial leads like Glimmora, Deoxys-S, and Greninja and set up entry hazards really help Cloyster sweep through teams.

Dual Screens Setters: While Pokemon like Klefki and Grimmsnarl, which are famously superb dual screens setters are helpful, more low-key setters like Jirachi and Tinkaton can get screens up without necessarily attracting the attention of Brick Break or Defog users.

Checks and Counters

Special Attackers: Cloyster can almost never set up against special attackers, as they will easily one shot it. Vacuum Wave users such as Iron Valiant, Keldeo, and Ursaluna-B deserve special mention because they can OHKO it with very little prior damage.

Anti-setup Technology: Cloyster will often demand at least one response to its setup. This can include a faster Pokemon that does not mind its attacks holding a Mirror Herb to set up alongside it, a bulky Red Card user that can tank one of its attacks and force it out, or priority users like Raging Bolt and Rillaboom that can use their super effective STAB attacks to take it out. However, the latter do have to fear its powerful Ice Shard.

Bulky Water-types: Having no option to hit Pokemon like Alomomola, Primarina, and Rotom-W super effectively makes it much harder for Cloyster to sweep. Teams with a glaring Cloyster weakness may also make Tera Water a solid choice for their Tera Captains.

Faster Boosted Pokemon: Pokemon such as Iron Valiant, Sneasler, and Iron Boulder that commonly boost their Speed can outspeed and revenge kill Cloyster, even when it is at +2 Speed.

Entry Hazards: When it is not practical for Cloyster to hold Heavy-Duty Boots, entry hazards can be a big hindrance for it, either breaking its Focus Sash or weakening it, making it easier for foes to revenge kill it.

movesets.name: Defensive Utility (Ice)
movesets.description: Due to Cloyster's Water typing, high Defense stat, and utility, it is able to tank hits from Steel-type Pokemon that are often threatening to Ice-types, such as Excadrill. Rapid Spin is an asset for defensive utility sets, allowing Cloyster to remove entry hazards such as Stealth Rock. Spikes can help provide chip damage to threats such as Iron Valiant and Heatran. Teleport allows Cloyster to keep momentum when it comes onto the field and pivot out of Pokemon that threaten it into teammates such as Weavile and Galarian Darmanitan. Hidden Power Fire can be used over Teleport to effectively deal with Scizor. Rocky Helmet allows Cloyster to punish physical moves it often switches into, such as U-turn from Corviknight and Crobat. Overcoat also helps reduce the damage Cloyster takes over time by negating sand damage. Defensive Cloyster works best on offensive teams that can take advantage of the Spikes it sets. Wallbreakers such as Galarian Darmanitan and Kyurem are very good teammates, as they can remove threats like Gholdengo, Archaludon, and Choice Band Hisuian Arcanine. Revenge killers such as Weavile, Cetitan, and Alolan Sandslash can check Pokemon such as Hisuian Goodra and Mega Gallade after Spikes damage, allowing sweepers to snowball more easily. Alolan Ninetales is another useful teammate, as it helps Cloyster with Aurora Veil, allowing it to tank special attacks better and set Spikes more easily against Pokemon that can often deny them, such as Keldeo.
